46901.meaning1: name of the eastern continent in Buddhist cosmology

examples.text: tasmiṃ sahassadhā loke sahassaṃ candānaṃ, sahassaṃ sūriyānaṃ, sahassaṃ sinerupabbatarājānaṃ, sahassaṃ jambudīpānaṃ, sahassaṃ aparagoyānānaṃ, sahassaṃ uttarakurūnaṃ, sahassaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ… ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu.
yo mahāmeruno kūṭaṃ, vimokkhena aphassayi, vanaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, ye ca bhūmisayā narā.

46903.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pubba

46905.meaning1: first teacher; foremost teacher; teachers of old

examples.text: pubb'ācariyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ… taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.
brahmā'ti mātāpitaro, pubb'ācariyā'ti vuccare, āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ, pajāya anukampakā.

46906.grammar: prp of pubbāpeti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
46906.commentary: (SNa) gattāni pubb'āpayamāno'ti gattāni pubbasadisāni vodakāni kurumāno. allasarīre pārutaṃ hi cīvaraṃ kilissati duggandhaṃ hoti, na c'etaṃ vattaṃ. (ANa) pubb'āpayamāno'ti rattadupaṭṭaṃ nivāsetvā uttarāsaṅgacīvaraṃ dvīhi hatthehi gahetvā pacchimalokadhātuṃ piṭṭhito katvā puratthimalokadhātuṃ abhimukho vodakabhāvena gattāni pubbasadisāni kurumāno aṭṭhāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: tap'ode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ. pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.

46907.commentary: (ANa) atthapubb'āparakusalo'ti heṭṭhā atthena upari atthaṃ jānāti, upari atthena heṭṭhā atthaṃ jānāti. kathaṃ? so hi heṭṭhā atthaṃ ṭhapetvā upari atthe vutte heṭṭhā attho atthī'ti jānāti. upari atthaṃ ṭhapetvā heṭṭhā atthe vutte'pi upari attho atthī'ti jānāti. ubhato ṭhapetvā majjhe atthe vutte ubhato attho atthī'ti jānāti. (DHPa) akkharānaṃ sannipātaṃ, jaññā pubb'āparāni cā'ti akkharānaṃ sannipātasaṅkhātaṃ akkharapiṇḍañ'ca jānāti, pubb'akkharena apar'akkharaṃ, apar'akkharena pubb'akkharañca jānāti. pubb'akkharena apar'akkharaṃ jānāti nāma, ādimhi paññāyamāne majjhapariyosānesu apaññāyamānesu'pi imesaṃ akkharānaṃ idaṃ majjhaṃ, idaṃ pariyosānan'ti jānāti. apar'akkharena pubbakkharaṃ jānāti nāma, ante paññāyamāne ādimajjhesu apaññāyamānesu imesaṃ akkharānaṃ idaṃ majjhaṃ, ayaṃ ādī'ti jānāti. majjhe paññāyamāne'pi imesaṃ akkharānaṃ ayaṃ ādi, ayaṃ anto'ti jānāti.

examples.text: vītataṇho anādāno, niruttipadakovido, akkharānaṃ sannipātaṃ, jaññā pubb'āparāni ca, sa ve antimasārīro mahāpañño, mahāpuriso'ti vuccati.

46908.meaning1: before and after; former and latter

46909.meaning1: skilled in the sequence; skilled in the order of exposition
46909.meaning2: skilled in sequence; skilled in order of exposition
46909.commentary: (ANa) byañjanakusalo'ti akkharappabhede cheko. pubb'āparakusalo'ti atthapubb'āparaṃ, dhammapubb'āparaṃ, akkharapubb'āparaṃ, byañjanapubb'āparaṃ, anusandhipubb'āparan'ti imasmiṃ pañcavidhe pubb'āpare cheko. tattha atthapubb'āparakusalo'ti heṭṭhā atthena upari atthaṃ jānāti, upari atthena heṭṭhā atthaṃ jānāti.

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti, dhammakusalo ca, byañjanakusalo ca, niruttikusalo ca, pubb'āparakusalo ca. ettāvatā kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, suggahitaggāhī ca, bahuñ'ca gaṇhāti, gahitañ'c'assa nappamussatī'ti.

46910.meaning1: successive; continuous; ever increasing; first one then the following

examples.text: ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.

46911.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of pubbāpara
46911.meaning1: before and after; initially and later; for ever more

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, muni pubb'āpare idha, ekacariyaṃ daḷhaṃ kayirā, na nisevetha methunaṃ.

46912.meaning1: name of a monastery outside Sāvatthī

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde
sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubb'ārāmo migāramātupāsādo ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.

46914.meaning1: rising before; waking up earlier; (comm) rising from one's seat
46914.commentary: (SNa) dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ disvā āsanato paṭhamataraṃ vuṭṭhātī'ti pubb'uṭṭhāyī.

examples.text: so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti. tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya. so upaṭṭhaheyya pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubb'upagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya, yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakapubbuḷaṃ uppajjati c'eva nirujjhati ca.

46917.commentary: (DHPa) tasmā yathā uppajjitvā bhijjan'atthena pubbuḷakaṃ ritta-tucch'ādi-bhāven'eva passeyya

examples.text: yathā pubbuḷakaṃ passe, yathā passe marīcikaṃ, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
vaṭṭani'r'iva koṭar'ohitā, majjhe pubbuḷakā sāssukā, pīḷakoḷikā c'ettha jāyati, vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca piṇḍitā.
pheṇapiṇḍ'ūpamaṃ rūpaṃ, vedanā pubbuḷ'opamā, marīcik'ūpamā saññā, saṅkhārā kadal'ūpamā, māy'ūpamañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, desit'ādiccabandhunā.

46920.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of pubba (+abl)
46920.meaning1: before; previously; formerly; in the past

examples.text: tassa evaṃ hoti, mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma'pi anusāsāma'pi. ime pan'amhākaṃ puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.
yo ca pubbe pamajjitvā, pacchā so nappamajjati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.

46921.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of pubba (+abl)

examples.text: kammadhārayasaññe ca samāse itthiyaṃ tuly'ādhikaraṇe pade pubbe bhāsitapum'itthī ce, pumā'va daṭṭhabbā. brāhmaṇadārikā, khattiyakaññā, khattiyakumārikā.
rudha'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato apaccayo hoti kattari, pubbe niggahit'āgamo hoti. rundhati, chindati, bhindati.

46922.commentary: (ANa) pubbekatahetū'ti pubbekatakāraṇā, pubbekatakammapaccayen'eva paṭisaṃvedetī'ti attho. iminā kammavedanañ'ca kiriyavedanañ'ca paṭikkhipitvā ekaṃ vipākavedanam'eva sampaṭicchanti.

examples.text: santi, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yaṃ kiñc'āyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetū'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti?

pubbekataṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyan'ti. iti karaṇīy'ākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo.

46924.meaning1: based on past action; due to past kamma
46924.commentary: (ANa) pubbekatahetū'ti pubbekatakāraṇā, pubbekatakammapaccayen'eva paṭisaṃvedetī'ti attho. iminā kammavedanañ'ca kiriyavedanañ'ca paṭikkhipitvā ekaṃ vipākavedanam'eva sampaṭicchanti.

examples.text: santi, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yaṃ kiñc'āyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetū'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti?

46925.commentary: (MNa) pubben'āparan'ti idha taruṇasamathavipassanāsu kammaṃ katvā samathavipassanā thāmajātā akaṃsu, ayaṃ pubbe viseso nāma. tato samāhitena cittena saṅkhāre sammasitvā keci sot'āpattiphalaṃ… keci arahattaṃ sacchikariṃsu. ayaṃ aparo uḷāro viseso nāma. (ANa) n'atthi me pubben'āparaṃ viseso'ti n'atthi mayhaṃ pubbena abhāvitakālena saddhiṃ aparaṃ bhāvitakāle viseso.

examples.text: idha, bhante ānanda, sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ sañjānantī'ti
te ca navā bhikkhū therehi bhikkhūhi ovadiyamānā anusāsiyamānā uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ jānanti.

46926.commentary: (VINa) pubbenivāsan'ti samanantar'ātītaṃ bhavaṃ ādiṃ katvā tattha tattha nivutthasantānaṃ.

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā satiyā sacchikaraṇīyā? pubbenivāso, bhikkhave, satiyā sacchikaraṇīyo.
n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.

46927.meaning2: remembrance of one's former state of existence

46928.meaning1: concerned with previous existences; related to previous lives
46928.commentary: (DNa) pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā'ti ekam'pi jātiṃ, dve'pi jātiyo'ti evaṃ vibhattena pubbenivutthakkhandha-santāna-saṅkhātena pubbenivāsena saddhiṃ yojetvā pavattitā.

examples.text: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi, iti'pi pubbenivāso, iti'pi pubbenivāso'ti.

46931.meaning2: remembrance of one's former state of existence

examples.text: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ

46932.meaning1: understanding from remembering one's previous lives; knowledge from the recollection of previous lives

examples.text: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ

46933.meaning1: teaching about knowledge from the recollection of previous lives

46934.meaning1: discussion about the recollection of one's previous lives and the knowledge of the divine eye
46934.sanskrit: pūrvanivāsa + anusmṛti + divya + cakṣus + jñāna + kathā

examples.text: pubbenivāsan'ti pubbenivutthakkhandha-param'paraṃ.
pubbenivāsan'ti pubbenivutthakkhandha-param'paraṃ.

46939.meaning2: remembrance of one's former state of existence

46940.meaning1: just before; previous to; as before

examples.text: pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi
idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
tato cut'āhaṃ vedeha, vajjīsu kulam'āgamā, n'ev'itthī na pumā āsiṃ, manussatte sudullabhe, tassa kammassa nissando, paradāragamanassa me.
331, 353. itthiyaṃ bhāsita-puma-itthī pumā'va ce.
itthī hutvā sv'ajja pumo'mhi devo, dibbehi kāmehi samaṅgibhūto, te coditā gotamasāvakena, saṃvegam'āpādu samecca gopakaṃ.
sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati bahinagare aparapure vanasaṇḍe.

46946.notes: sometimes puras or puro in comps

examples.text: paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.
tam'enaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya, pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya, uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya, dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
pakappitā saṅkhatā yassa dhammā, purakkhatā santi avīvadātā, yadattani passati ānisaṃsaṃ, taṃ nissito kuppapaṭicca santiṃ.
vītataṇho purā bhedā, pubbam'antam'anissito, vemajjhe n'upasaṅkheyyo, tassa n'atthi purakkhataṃ.

46949.grammar: pp of purakkharoti, comp vb (+instr or +gen)
46949.meaning1: attacked (by); assailed (by); afflicted (by); beset (by); (comm) wrapped with
46949.commentary: (MNa) purakkhato'ti lakkhaṃ viya sarassa sītassa purato, sītena bādhīyamāno'ti attho. (DHPa) tasmā'ti yasmā tasiṇāya purakkhatā paliveṭhitā sattā

examples.text: tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.

sītassa purakkhato uṇhassa purakkhato ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassehi rissamāno khuppipāsāya mīyamāno, ayam'pi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko, dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu.
seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ vā poriseyyaṃ pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ. so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya.

46951.meaning1: headed (by); preceded (by); at the forefront; with (somthing) in front

examples.text: kāmayogena saṃyuttā, bhavayogena c'ūbhayaṃ, diṭṭhiyogena saṃyuttā, avijjāya purakkhatā.

46952.grammar: abs of purakkharoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
46952.meaning1: having put in front; having given priority (to)
46952.commentary: (MNa) purakkhatvā purakkhatvā'ti purato purato katvā, samparivāretvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vata mam'eva bhikkhū purakkhatvā purakkhatvā gāmaṃ bhattāya paviseyyuṃ, na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū purakkhatvā purakkhatvā gāmaṃ bhattāya paviseyyun'ti.

46953.grammar: abs of purakkharoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)

46954.grammar: prp of purakkharoti, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, purakkharāno hoti? idha, gahapati, ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatam'addhānaṃ

46957.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of pura (+gen)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggappaṭipanno. tassa purato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo pacchato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo.
purato pacchato vā'pi, aparo ce na vijjati, atīva phāsu bhavati, ekassa vasato vane.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggappaṭipanno. tassa purato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo pacchato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo.

46959.meaning1: before; in front; in the future
46959.synonym: pamukhe, pubbaṃ, pubbe, pura, puratthato, pure
46959.commentary: (SNa) na tassa pacchā na purattham'atthī'ti pacchā vuccati atītaṃ, puratthaṃ vuccati anāgataṃ, atīt'ānāgatesu khandhesu chandarāgavirahitassa pacchā vā puratthaṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadati.

examples.text: na tassa pacchā na purattham'atthi, santo vidhūmo anigho nirāso, nikkhittadaṇḍo tasathāvaresu, so ty'āhutiṃ bhuñjatu aggapiṇḍaṃ.

upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthā-abhimukho nisīdi. bhikkhusaṅgho'pi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthā-abhimukho nisīdi, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.

46961.synonym: atītamaddhānaṃ, paṭikacca, pubbassudaṃ, pubbe, pure, bhūtapubbaṃ

examples.text: pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, manussabhūto bahunaṃ sukh'āvaho, ubbhega-uttāsa-bhay'āpanūdano, guttīsu rakkh'āvaraṇesu ussuko.
gihim'pi santaṃ upavattatī jano, bahu puratthāpakatena kammunā, akiñcanaṃ pabbajitaṃ anuttaraṃ, buddham'pi santaṃ upavattati jano'ti.

46963.meaning1: facing east; orientated in an easterly direction

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratth'ābhimukho nisīdi. bhikkhusaṅgho'pi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratth'ābhimukho nisīdi, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.
tam'enaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya, pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya, uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya, dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
puratthimāya ce'pi disāya puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati? yañ'ca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa puratthim'ante udakaṃ, yañ'ca pacchim'ante udakaṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena āvasathāgāraṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthim'ābhimukho nisīdi.

46968.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of pura (+abl)

examples.text: vītataṇho purā bhedā, pubbam'antam'anissito, vemajjhe n'upasaṅkheyyo, tassa n'atthi purakkhataṃ.
purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo

46969.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of pura

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.
purāṇaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, nave khantiṃ na kubbaye, hiyyamāne na soceyya, ākāsaṃ na sito siyā.
yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, senti cāp'ātikhīṇā'va, purāṇāni anutthunaṃ.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

evaṃ, bho, purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho, āsitt'odakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca udakañ'ca. chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha, mā yoggāni kilamitthā'ti.

46975.meaning1: before; past; old times; old days

examples.text: na te idaṃ citta yathā purāṇakaṃ, n'āhaṃ alaṃ tuyha vase nivattituṃ, mah'esino pabbajito'mhi sāsane, na mādisā honti vināsadhārino.
muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī, agamī buddhavarassa santikaṃ, passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, cakkhu āsi yathā purāṇakan'ti.

46976.meaning1: (resulting as a consequence of) previous action; former deed
46976.commentary: (SNa) cakkhu, bhikkhave, purāṇakamman'ti na cakkhu purāṇaṃ, kammam'eva purāṇaṃ, kammato pana nibbattattā paccayanāmena evaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, purāṇakammaṃ? cakkhu, bhikkhave, purāṇakammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ … jivhā purāṇakammā abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā vedaniyā daṭṭhabbā … mano purāṇakammo abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedaniyo daṭṭhabbo. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, purāṇakammaṃ.

46978.meaning1: former courtesan; (comm) wife of a deceased accountant
46978.commentary: (VINa) purāṇagaṇakiyā'ti ekassa gaṇakassa bhariyāya, sā tasmiṃ jīvamāne gaṇakī'ti paññāyittha, mate pana purāṇagaṇakī'ti saṅkhaṃ gatā.

46979.commentary: (MNa) purāṇagihisahāyo'ti pubbe gihikāle sahāyo. ayam'pi dīgh'āyuko'va theraṃ pabbajitaṃ passituṃ gacchanto asītime vasse gato.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā bākulo rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho acelakassapo āyasmato bākulassa purāṇagihisahāyo yen'āyasmā bākulo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā bākulena saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.

46985.meaning1: former founder of a religious order; previous religious leader

examples.text: atha kho tāyano devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

46986.commentary: (UDa) purāṇadutiyikā'ti pubbe gihikāle pādaparicaraṇavasena dutiyikā, bhariyā'ti attho.

examples.text: assosi kho āyasmato saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā, ayyo kira saṅgāmaji sāvatthiṃ anuppatto'ti. sā dārakaṃ ādāya jetavanaṃ agamāsi.

46987.commentary: (SNt) pubbakehi mah'esīhi paṭipanno hi ariyamaggo itarehi antarā kehici avaḷañjito'ti vuttaṃ avaḷañjan'aṭṭhena purāṇamaggo'ti.

examples.text: ayaṃ kho so, bhikkhave, purāṇamaggo purāṇ'añjaso pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyāto, tam'anugacchiṃ
tena kho pana samayena samīti yānakāraputto rathassa nemiṃ tacchati. tam'enaṃ paṇḍuputto ājīvako purāṇayānakāraputto paccupaṭṭhito hoti.

46989.meaning1: former harem lady; woman previously belonging to the king's harem
46989.commentary: (VINa) purāṇarāj'orodhā'ti purāṇe gihibhāve rañño orodhā. (PYt) rañño orodhā rājorodhā, purāṇe rājorodhā purāṇarāj'orodhā'ti vacan'atthaṃ dassento āha purāṇe'tiādi. gihibhāve'ti iminā purāṇe'ti ettha ṇapaccayassa sarūpaṃ dasseti.

46990.meaning1: former harem lady; woman previously belonging to the king's harem
46990.commentary: (VINa) purāṇarāj'orodhā'ti purāṇe gihibhāve rañño orodhā. (PYt) rañño orodhā rājorodhā, purāṇe rājorodhā purāṇarāj'orodhā'ti vacan'atthaṃ dassento āha purāṇe'tiādi. gihibhāve'ti iminā purāṇe'ti ettha ṇapaccayassa sarūpaṃ dasseti.

46991.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.5) purāṇasanthataṃ nāma sakiṃ nivattham'pi sakiṃ pārutam'pi. (VINa) sakiṃ nivattham'pi sakiṃ pārutam'pī'ti sakiṃ nisinnañ'c'eva nipannañ'ca.

examples.text: nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasantha tassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

46992.meaning1: former spiritual companion; who was previously a fellow monk
46992.commentary: (ANa) purāṇasabrahmacārī'ti porāṇako sabrahmacārī. so kira āḷārakālāmakāle tasmiṃ'y'eva assame ahosi, taṃ sandhāy'evam'āha.

examples.text: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, n'atthi, bhante, kapilavatthusmiṃ tathārūpo āvasatho yatthajja bhagavā ekarattiṃ vihareyya. ayaṃ, bhante, bharaṇḍu kālāmo bhagavato purāṇasabrahmacārī. tass'ajja bhagavā assame ekarattiṃ viharatū'ti.

46993.meaning1: who was a former blood-relative; previously related; who was formerly a family member

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa purāṇasālohitā devatā anukampikā atthakāmā bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya yena bāhiyo dārucīriyo ten'upasaṅkami

tena kho pana samayena sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā uddiṭṭhā honti, yo te, sabhiya, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho byākaroti tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsī'ti.

46994.meaning1: previously a judge; formerly a magistrate
46994.commentary: (VINa) purāṇavohāriko mah'āmatto'ti bhikkhubhāvato purāṇe gihikāle vinicchayavohāre niyuttattā, vohāriko'ti saṅkhaṃ gato mahāamacco.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇavohāriko mah'āmatto bhikkhūsu pabbajito bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.

46995.commentary: (VINa) seyyathā'pi purāṇ'āsikoṭṭho'ti yathā nāma purāṇacammakāro'ti attho. yathā hi cammakāro cammaṃ vitthataṃ karissāmī'ti ito c'ito ca samañchati, kaḍḍhati, evaṃ so'pi taṃ nisīdanaṃ.

examples.text: kissa tvaṃ, udāyi, nisīdanaṃ samantato samañchasi, seyyathā'pi purāṇ'āsikoṭṭho'ti?

46996.meaning2: ancient, old, worn out, used, former

46998.commentary: (KVt) tatiyāya rattiyā pur'āruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasantassā'ti tatiyāya rattiyā aruṇato puretaram'eva nikkhamitvā aruṇaṃ bahi uṭṭhāpetvā catutthadivase atthaṅ'gate sūriye puna vasantassa.

examples.text: anāpatti dvetisso rattiyo vasati, ūnakadvetisso rattiyo vasati, dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā pur'āruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati, sabbacchanne, sabbaaparicchanne, sabbaparicchanne sabbaacchanne, yebhuyyena acchanne, yebhuyyena aparicchanne

46999.meaning1: primary giver; first donor; epithet of Sakka
46999.commentary: (DNa) vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakk'opāgā purin'dado'ti vasūnaṃ devatānaṃ seṭṭho vāsavo yo sakko'ti ca, purin'dado'ti ca vuccati, so'pi āgato. (MNa) purin'dadassā'ti sabbapaṭhamaṃ dhammadānadāyakassa
46999.notes: Pāḷi corruption of Vedic puraṃdara 'destroyer of strongholds', an epithet of Indra.

examples.text: vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakk'opāgā purin'dado, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.
isisattamassa akuhassa, tevijjassa brahmapattassa, nhātakassa padakassa, passaddhassa viditavedassa, purin'dadassa sakkassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
